title: vocab-links@1: which meaning units a language's vocabulary words carry
description: meaning/vocab-links/<language>.jsonl. The first line is the header; every later line links one word of languages/<language>/vocab.jsonl to the content meanings (meaning@1 ids) it carries, so vocabulary, translation and the meaning network share the same units. Lines follow the vocab file's order.

language.description: The language id; must match the file name and a folder in languages/ with a vocab.jsonl.

vocab.description: A vocab@1 id, exactly: the deck id, a slash, and the word.

meanings.description: The content meanings the word carries, most central first.
